modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
implement safe working practices for dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
conduct regular checks of the machines with support of the maintenance team to identify potential hazards
ensure that all the tools/equipment/fasteners/spare parts are arranged as per specifications/utility into proper trays, cabinets, lockers as mentioned in the 5S guidelines/work instructions
organise safety drills or training sessions to create awareness amongst others on the identified risks and safety practices
fill daily check sheet to report improvements done and risks identified
ensure that relevant safety boards/signs are placed on the shop floor for the safety of self and others
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workplace, equipment, restrooms etc. are sanitized regularly
ensure team is aware about hygiene and sanitation regulations and following them on the shop floor
ensure availability of running water, hand wash and alcohol-based sanitizers at the workplace
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques and support employees to cope with stress, anxiety etc
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
ensure recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous wastes are segregated as per SOP
ensure proper mechanism is followed while collecting and disposing of non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste
ensure malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment are resolved effectively
prepare and analyze material and energy audit reports to decipher excessive consumption of material and water
identify possibilities of using renewable energy and environment friendly fuels
identify processes where material and energy/electricity utilization can be optimized

modules.module_title: Define the design targets for the Electrical/Electronic systems

pcs.pc_description: Identify the parameters that can cause malfunctioning and enhance performance of vehicle by automation
Set the goals for engineering teams, hardware and software suppliers and associates providing services for creating suitable designs of the vehicle
Define the functional targets for design- simulation-prototyping-testing engineers

modules.module_title: Develop the systems from concept to production drawing release stage

pcs.pc_description: Deploy resources to generate design concepts complying with quality and cost targets
Design the Electrical/Electronic/Mechanical systems as per Product Quality plan (APQP) fulfilling the time and cost constraints
Apply appropriate technologies to meet the goals set for design, simulation, rapid-prototyping, validation
Co-ordinate with design teams to develop systems compatible to each other and complying with the design safety standards
Identify all potential hazards out of system malfunctioning
Prepare comprehensive list of critical and non- critical risks arising out of hazardous operations
Monitor the engineering activities with a focus on the risk mitigation activities

modules.module_title: Validate each system for compliance to standards

pcs.pc_description: Analyse each system function by simulating normal performance and failure under critical conditions
Integrate systems on vehicle sub-systems to test virtually the design targets for performance and failures
Validate system performance on vehicle and clearly identify failure modes and corrective actions
Release final design after vehicle homologation tests on safety critical systems
Modify designs based on feedback from handlers in the product lifecycle or as part of continuous improvement, re-engineering or value- engineering and perform validation testing for safety compliance

modules.module_title: Report and record data on safety analysis and progress of activities related to design safety

pcs.pc_description: Perform safety analysis on each system at pre- defined intervals
Report the progress of safety related activities including failures, omissions and delays
Record all product engineering steps in the light of design safety for compliance audits or quality conformance

modules.module_title: Identify the elements for virtual validation of the design (DV) of parts and of the integration (PV) of systems

pcs.pc_description: Ensure availability of an array of CAE & CAD software, high performance computers and servers (local/cloud)
Identify vehicle parts and operating conditions (load cases) to undergo CAE simulations (apt boundary condition)
Identify electrical/electronic parts of each system and mechanical parts of each assembly for design verification
Identify each aspect of vehicle integration and operations that calls for CAE simulation

modules.module_title: Develop Virtual Product Development (VPD) plan for CAE simulations in sync with the Vehicle Development Plan (VDP)

pcs.pc_description: Ensure that the capability matrix and workload / capacity schedule are mutually supportive
Develop detailed plan for simulations (light and server-intensive) best utilising the available computing resources
Conduct virtual validation reviews in conjunction with Initial-Interim-Final Design Release and DV-PV-PPV Testing

modules.module_title: Develop CAE models common for FEA, CFD, MDB and discrete F.E models for individual analysis methods

pcs.pc_description: Plan CAE strategy for pre-processing suiting the simulations (Crash/CFD/NVH) as per the VPD plan
Lead F.E Meshing team in co-ordination with system design teams to make concurrent changes on F.E models
Monitor development of compatible F.E mesh common for analysis types (structure/fluid/acoustic)

modules.module_title: Monitor the design safety verifications complying to crash safety standards and part failure conditions

pcs.pc_description: Conduct virtual validation of electrical/electronic/mechanical parts for design integrity
Lead CAE simulation under extreme operating conditions for static/dynamic/transient conditions
Lead analysis of failure modes on safety critical parts and vehicle sub-assemblies
Monitor the post-processing and result- interpretation records at all stages of CAE

modules.module_title: Perform virtual validation in coherence with designing, re-designing, re-engineering stages in the product lifecycle

pcs.pc_description: Schedule all CAE simulation activities for accurate & timely results during designing, re- designing, re-engineering
Archive digital records systematically in a safe environment for easy retrieval during the stipulated time window by following organisational procedures
